The '''double screen formation''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] deployment maneuver. In [[36 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] used a double screen formation to conduct a search for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[StealthX]]s in the [[Murgo Choke]].
